blind.description: A rectangular carved stone plaque or memorial marker standing upright. It features a framed border with pyramid-shaped corner studs and a carved relief of a laurel wreath and rectangular inscription slots on its front face. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, broken, or melted elements. The material resembles stylized beige or sandstone with subtle painted edge wear and shadows.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal rectangular block with slightly wider square caps at both ends and small pointed studs projecting from the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 feet tall (roughly one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide.
